title: Flatten the staircase of error checks
summary: Turn nested err == nil branches into early returns so the happy path sits at the left margin.

turns.user: config.Load walks off the right edge of my screen. please fix

assistant.body: Go reads the other way around: return the error first and keep the happy path at the left margin. Every else goes away, and falling off the bottom means success.

turns.user: much better. one more thing, i cannot tell which step failed. just the decode one needs the file name

assistant.body: Note: this needs fmt in the import block. Only the decode return changes, and %w keeps the chain so the caller can still reach the inner error with errors.Is.
sed -i '' -e '/Decode(&raw)/{' -e 'n' -e 's|return nil, err|return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode %s: %w", path, err)|' -e '}' internal/config/load.go
